description: doctrine — shows each dispatched seat while it runs. In a herdr session (HERDR_ENV=1) it panes the seat directly; in a contained agent (DCTR_VIEW_REQUEST_DIR set) it only writes a request file to that mount for a host-side watcher, calling no herdr. With neither set it stands down, costing one process spawn per hook event and nothing else — and that is more than one per seat: Claude Code also fires SubagentStop for its own forked queries (a prompt suggestion after most turns, memory extraction), each with an empty agent_type, so a session that dispatches no seats still spawns roughly once per turn. SessionStart after /clear (matcher clear) runs dctr-restore.mjs: when SESSION_MEMORY.md's kickoff names a handoff whose record's last state line reads Open or Blocked, it hands the new session the phase, the record path, that state line, the wrapper and the handoff as facts; otherwise it prints nothing and calls no herdr. PostToolBatch runs dctr-gauge.mjs: while that record is Open or Blocked, its last auto-cycle on/off line is on and no .doctrine/auto-cycle.stop exists in the session's repo or the record's, it reads the main session's context use and, the first time it reaches the record's tier, hands the session the warning as facts and appends `- auto-cycle: warned <session id> <tier>` to the record, once per session id; a seat's batch (agent_id present) and every other case stand down, and it calls no herdr. While auto-cycle is on it also reports, on every batch, each tier or window error and each unknown context reading as facts, in additionalContext plus a systemMessage. Stop, Notification (matcher permission_prompt|idle_prompt), StopFailure and UserPromptSubmit run dctr-cycle.mjs, the auto-cycle hook: each stands down, as does a subagent's event, unless that record is Open or Blocked and its last auto-cycle on/off line is on. With a .doctrine/auto-cycle.stop in the session's repo or the record's, Stop appends one paused line naming that file and alerts it, and Notification and StopFailure append nothing. Otherwise Stop appends `- auto-cycle paused: <reason>` to the record for a Blocked phase, an alarm without a ruling or an open question; before this session's warned line, or while an unresolved paused line follows it, it does nothing more; it waits while seats, gates, background tasks not yet completed, failed or killed, or crons are live, or until the message ends with the ready line; then it pauses when the handoff is not written, the session is contained, another Stop hook kept it running, herdr cannot read the pane or reports another Claude session in it, the tree cannot be hashed, the cycle cap is reached, two cycles made no progress, or the transcript cannot be read, and otherwise, once per record state, spawns dctr-typer.mjs detached, which types /clear and then the /doctrine:doctrine-resume command into the session's herdr pane once focus moves off it; a pause for a Blocked phase, an alarm or an open question stops holding the cycle once a later line in the record answers it. On a permission prompt, an idle prompt nothing explains (no paused line stands but a permission prompt, idle stop or API error the session has ended a turn since, no typer claim is held, no seat, gate or codex job is live, and the last Stop recorded no background task or cron and a message not ending with the ready line), or an API error Notification and StopFailure append a paused line too, a prompt or an error of the same kind again only once a turn has ended since. A Stop, a StopFailure and UserPromptSubmit each record where the session's turn ended; UserPromptSubmit does nothing else. Each standing paused line is alerted once, as a herdr notification when the session has a herdr pane and as a systemMessage printed by the next Stop, Notification or StopFailure; while auto-cycle is active the `autocycle` sidebar token names the last standing pause, or the cycle count when none stands. With DCTR_VIEW_REQUEST_DIR set they call no herdr. When SessionStart after /clear injects, it also records the record's line count as the session's start and, when HERDR_PANE_ID is set, writes a restore file under TMPDIR/dctr-autocycle, which the typer waits for.
